svg.title: How to host a test version of your app without replacing production (2026)
svg.desc: Two lanes: the main branch deploys production, which customers use with the production database; a feature branch deploys a preview at its own URL with its own test database; merging the pull request releases the change to production. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.

g.text: A test version next to production
Preview per branch, its own test database, merge to release
Its own URL to test on
